verdict.rationale: Radar documents value lists that group values for reference in rules, with a REST API for programmatic management. It also documents allow lists such as trusted customer IDs and custom rules created in the Dashboard, so the core list capability exists on both surfaces. However, velocity limits are not evidenced, the specific list types (emails, cards, devices, IPs) are not explicitly documented, and allow rules may require contacting support to enable. missing for 10: documented velocity limits/rate rules, explicit email/card/device/IP list types, independent hands-on corroboration of list management via API.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can maintain allow and block lists — emails, cards, devices, IPs — and velocity limits, managed through the dashboard and programmatically

citations.quote: Value lists allow you to group values together which can then be referenced in rules.
Customer IDs for trusted customers: Use this list to automatically allow payments by these customers.
you can also create custom rules in the Dashboard.
